fit_parameters.loss: sum of unweighted logistic negative log likelihood + 0.5*slope^2

inputs.seed_and_threshold_rule: First twelve games in the previously frozen salted fit list, no replacement for censored games or absent crossings. At every placement t (including terminal) from an empty board, locate the first boundary with previous N>h and current N<=h. Levels 256/128 are the healthy comparators, 84/48/32/16 are the prespecified risk landmarks. Use pre-action state on arrival, deduplicate seed+offset; terminal boundaries have no eligible action. Freeze all coordinates before any actor or action logits are loaded.
inputs.exclusions: All twelve archive-test seeds plus all earlier excluded discovery, pilot, current reserved and historical nontraining seeds.

method: Base is the exact expanded incumbent, native exhaustive shortlist, teacher prior + actor FP32. The frozen, fitted H128 log1p(count) logistic score is evaluated in float64 on every actual next board. Risk is exactly 1 for zero. Rank FP32 base minus lambda times FP32 risk for lambda=1,4, cross-check FP64 argmax. Every recorded alternative includes original rank/margin, raw gain, and forecast delta. Materialize baseline, maximum mobility move, and every flip for validation. Inputs are training-side archived behavior; the frozen observational model was trained in these games. A lower forecast after an alternative does not establish longer actual survival.
